spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']

purchase_cols = ['NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']

axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Income')

axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Income')

# 3. Age distribution
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=15, kde=True, ax=axes[0, 2])

axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count')

# 4. Spending by product category
spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean().reset_index()
spending_data.columns = ['Product_Category', 'Average_Spending']

axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Spending by Product Category')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Product Category')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Spending')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].mean().reset_index()
purchase_data.columns = ['Purchase_Channel', 'Average_Purchases']
sns.barplot(data=purchase_data, x='Purchase_Channel', y='Average_Purchases', ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Purchases by Channel')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Purchase Channel')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Recency distribution
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=10, kde=True, ax=axes[1, 2])

axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Recency (Days)')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count')

# 7. Family composition
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()

# 8. Customer enrollment over time

axes[2, 1].set_title('Customer Enrollment Over Time')
axes[2, 1].set_xlabel('Year')
axes[2, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Customers')

# 9. Web visits vs store purchases
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='NumWebVisitsMonth', y='NumStorePurchases', 
                hue='Total_Spending', size='Total_Spending', sizes=(50, 200), ax=axes[2, 2])
axes[2, 2].set_title('Web Visits vs Store Purchases (Colored by Total Spending)')
axes[2, 2].set_xlabel('Monthly Web Visits')
axes[2, 2].set_ylabel('Store Purchases')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
